description.value:
Rank 3 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 20 Ki
  • Casting Time: When you take the Attack Action
  • Range: Melee
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: For the duration of the Attack Action.

You focus all your power into speed into a series of fast moving attacks.

For the duration of this Technique you gain additional Movement Speed equal to your Base Movement Speed and gain an additional 2d6 Thunder Damage for each 10 feet you move in a straight line between Attack Rolls.

system.duration: For the duration of the *Attack Action.*
